title: How to fall in love with your life AGAIN?
excerpt: - stop expecting from everyone - stop taking things personally - don't beg for love or attention - keep emotions under control - disconnect for a while - let…
body:
- stop expecting from everyone
- stop taking things personally
- don't beg for love or attention
- keep emotions under control
- disconnect for a while
- let people go
- sit with your thoughts often
- not everyone cares, digest it
- stop pleasing everyone around
- walk away if you don't like it
- let go of the past
- don't let "people" decide your happiness
